segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the treatment is gentle with no irritation while still clearing breakouts.

concerns.spots: Reviewers describe individual pimples and deep hormonal spots shrinking, sometimes overnight, with breakouts healing faster and stopping before fully forming.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer or shorter-lasting breakouts overall, with one calling it a go-to for stopping sudden breakouts before they develop.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a noticeable reduction in redness by the next morning alongside calming of the skin.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers state the product does not dry out or leave skin flaky, unlike other spot treatments they compare it to; no reviewer reports dryness as a side effect.

aspects.libelle: No dryness or flaking despite acne actives
No stinging or irritation on application

extraits.texte: I struggle with hormonal breakouts and this has been a lifesaver. It shrinks those deep, painful spots without irritation.
Finally found a spot treatment that doesn't leave my skin flaky. It targets pimples without making everything else dry.
I noticed a big reduction in redness by morning. It calms my skin while treating the acne, which I really appreciate.
I have sensitive skin, so I'm picky with acne products. This one is gentle but still gets the job done. No irritation, just clearer skin.

extraits.titre: Smooths and clears at the same time
extraits.texte: Not only does it clear my pimples, but my skin feels smoother too. The glycolic acid really helps with texture.
The mix of salicylic acid and glycolic acid really makes a difference. My pores look cleaner and my breakouts heal much faster now.

reserve: Only ten reviews are available and just one mentions a specific skin type, so segmentation by skin type is thin.
